'''2007 Maryland State Championship Daniel Brittain DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Daniel Brittain]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Danny Britton
* '''Deck name:''' Bespin's Sexual Dungeon of Doom!!!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
